en: Officially received my Ph.D. in Civil Engineering (Transportation Engineering) from the University of Massachusetts Amherst. 🎓
zh: 正式获得麻省大学阿默斯特分校土木工程（交通运输工程方向）博士学位。🎓

en: Successfully defended my Ph.D. dissertation, “Quality-Aware Multi-LiDAR Framework for Traffic Perception and Safety Analysis,” in Civil & Environmental Engineering at the University of Massachusetts Amherst.
zh: 顺利通过麻省大学阿默斯特分校土木与环境工程博士论文答辩，论文题目为 “Quality-Aware Multi-LiDAR Framework for Traffic Perception and Safety Analysis”。

en: Paper “MulDet3D: multi-objective optimization based unsupervised object detection for multiple roadside LiDARs” accepted at Journal of Transportation Engineering Part A: Systems (ASCE JTE Part A).
zh: MulDet3D: multi-objective optimization based unsupervised object detection for multiple roadside LiDARs被 Journal of Transportation Engineering Part A: Systems（ASCE JTE Part A）接收。

en: Paper “FRGB3D: fast reliability-weighted Gaussian background modeling for roadside LiDAR traffic monitoring” accepted at Journal of Computing in Civil Engineering (ASCE JCCE).
zh: FRGB3D: fast reliability-weighted Gaussian background modeling for roadside LiDAR traffic monitoring被 Journal of Computing in Civil Engineering（ASCE JCCE）接收。

en: Preprint “Infrastructure-centric world models: bridging temporal depth and spatial breadth for roadside perception” posted on arXiv. [arXiv:2604.17651]
zh: Infrastructure-centric world models: bridging temporal depth and spatial breadth for roadside perception预印本发布至 arXiv：arXiv:2604.17651。

en: Presented a poster on “Quality-aware vehicle conflict detection with spatial precision enhancement for roadside multi-LiDAR systems” at Safe Mobility Conference 2026 in Seattle WA.
zh: 在美国西雅图举行的 Safe Mobility Conference 2026 上，以墙报形式报告了Quality-aware vehicle conflict detection with spatial precision enhancement for roadside multi-LiDAR systems。

en: Paper “A multi-objective optimization method for integrated road asset management considering traffic dynamics and environmental impacts” accepted at Transportation Research Record (TRR).
zh: A multi-objective optimization method for integrated road asset management considering traffic dynamics and environmental impacts被 Transportation Research Record（TRR）接收。

en: Presented a poster on “FRGB3D: fast reliability-weighted Gaussian background modeling for roadside LiDAR traffic monitoring” at TRB 2026 Annual Meeting in Washington D.C.
zh: 在美国华盛顿特区举行的 TRB 2026 年会上，以墙报形式报告了FRGB3D: fast reliability-weighted Gaussian background modeling for roadside LiDAR traffic monitoring。

en: Two papers published in Proc. SPIE 13575 (STCE 2024): “Estimating travel mode choices of residents in Stockholm region” and “Analysis of expressway maintenance decision based on complete information static game theory.”
zh: Estimating travel mode choices of residents in Stockholm region与Analysis of expressway maintenance decision based on complete information static game theory两篇论文发表于 Proc. SPIE 13575（STCE 2024）。

en: Presented a poster on “Multi-objective optimization method for integrated roadway asset maintenance and rehabilitation considering traffic impacts” at TRB 2025 Annual Meeting in Washington D.C.
zh: 在美国华盛顿特区举行的 TRB 2025 年会上，以墙报形式报告了Multi-objective optimization method for integrated roadway asset maintenance and rehabilitation considering traffic impacts。

en: Paper on “Network-level pavement maintenance and rehabilitation planning considering uncertainties using chance-constrained programming” published in International Journal of Pavement Engineering.
zh: Network-level pavement maintenance and rehabilitation planning considering uncertainties using chance-constrained programming发表于 International Journal of Pavement Engineering。
